After a dictation, Whisper++ notices when you edit the inserted text in the same field. Only the edited words plus up to 3 words around each edit leave the device, and only to the review model you choose here (or your enhancement model). Nothing is captured in password or private fields, apps you blocked, or when the text was auto-sent.

Immediately: corrections are learned in the background; when the app is open you'll see “Learned N corrections” with Undo for 30 seconds. Daily / Manually: corrections wait for you under “Review now”.

Auto-Learn is off by default; turn it off here at any time.

When on, edits you make to dictated text are reviewed by an AI model. Only the edited words plus up to 3 words around each edit are sent, and only to the review provider chosen in Dictionary settings (by default your enhancement provider). Nothing is captured in password or private fields or in apps blocked below. Turn it off in Dictionary settings.
